task: Use /api/products to list all products. How many total products are available?

Use /api/categories to list product categories. How many categories are there?

Get product ID 1 via /api/products/1. What is its name?
Use /api/brands to list all brands. How many distinct brands are available?

Log in as shopper_arivera (password: pass123) via POST /api/login. Then add product 1 to cart via POST /api/cart/1 with product_id=1, quantity=2.
